name: Git Safety Guard
description: Blocks accidental git operations in Phases 1-6. Allows commit/push in Phase 7 (SonarQube scan requires pushed code) and Phase 8 (final audit push to GitHub).

then.prompt:
WORKSPACE POLICY CHECK: If this shell command contains git checkout, git branch -d, git reset, git rebase, or any destructive operation, it is BLOCKED unless the user explicitly requested it.

However, git add, git commit, and git push ARE ALLOWED in Phase 7 and Phase 8 of the migration because:
- Phase 7 requires code to be committed and pushed for SonarQube scanner to analyze it
- Phase 8 requires final audit report commit and push to GitHub

Check Migration/.migration-state.json to verify current phase. If currentPhase is 7 or 8 (or 'complete'), allow git add/commit/push. Otherwise block them.

Build commands (mvn, dotnet, gradle), test commands, and read-only git commands (git status, git diff, git log) are ALWAYS safe to proceed.
